permissionNamingConvention: service::resource::action — matching the platform's own style (blocks-data::schema::create-schema-index) and the placeholder already used in P0_POLICY_FIXES.json (inventory::balance::write).

howThisIsConsumed.dataGateway: Row-level policies compare AUTH 'roles' (LeftOperand 'roles', Operator CONTAIN=6) or 'permissions' against a StaticValue. Every placeholder policy in P0_POLICY_FIXES.json and COMMERCE_SCHEMAS_DRAFT.json is currently scoped to the built-in 'admin' role and is meant to be renarrowed to the roles below once they exist.
howThisIsConsumed.apps: ecommerce-back-office/src/lib/blocks/access.ts already exposes useHasRole()/useHasPermission() reading the IAM token's roles/permissions arrays. It is wired to Edit/Delete gating today via list-config.ts and will consult these role names unchanged once they are issued.

status: DRAFT — not created. Run `blocks iam roles list` first: some of these may already exist, and this file was written without CLI access to check.

roles.description: Full access. Already exists as the platform built-in and is what every placeholder policy currently names.
roles.notes: Do not create — this is the built-in. Listed so the mapping below is complete.

roles.description: Creates and maintains products, variants, categories, brands and media.
roles.notes: storage::media::upload backs the product image upload already shipped in image-upload-field.tsx.

roles.description: Works the order queue: status transitions, cancellations, customer lookups.
roles.notes: Replaces the 'admin' placeholder in COMMERCE_SCHEMAS_DRAFT.json's 'staff can read all orders' and 'staff can edit orders' policies. Needed before sequence step S9.

roles.description: Owns a warehouse: approves and dispatches transfers, adjusts balances, oversees operators.
roles.notes: inventory::transfer::approve is the app-level gate stock-transfer-actions.ts currently checks as the 'admin' role.

roles.description: Day-to-day stock work: counts, adjustments, picking. No approvals.
roles.notes: This is the role P0_POLICY_FIXES.json's two WarehouseInventory policies are named after and should be renarrowed to. Deliberately has no ::approve permission.
::approve and ::close are the two steps purchase-order-actions.ts gates on 'admin' today. ::goods-receipt::write anticipates sequence step S23.

roles.description: Reads cost and financial data; confirms payments. No catalog or stock authority.
roles.notes: commerce::payment::confirm is the manual payment-confirmation action that replaces a PSP webhook (sequence step S26). read-cost pairs with the field-level follow-up in P0_POLICY_FIXES.md.

roles.description: Reads orders and customer profiles to answer questions. Cannot change stock or prices.
roles.notes: Deliberately narrower than Order manager: no status transitions.

roles.description: Read-only across everything, including the immutable movement ledger.
roles.notes: Read-only by construction — grant no ::write/::edit/::delete to this role. Pairs with making InventoryMovement read non-Public (task breakdown §1.3).
